name: citation-needed
description: No claim without a receipt. Verifies every factual claim in a draft against live sources and returns an evidence ledger. Never silently rewrites.

interface.shortDescription: Fact-check any draft against live sources
interface.longDescription: Extracts every check-worthy factual claim from a draft, verifies each one with web search against the two-source-or-one-primary standard, and returns an evidence ledger with honest statuses. Flags problems in place; never silently rewrites.
defaultPrompt: Use citation-needed to fact-check this draft.
Verify every claim in this text and give me the ledger.
Just the problems: which claims in this draft are wrong?
